create_wigner_data_module: create a WignerDataModule with precomputed Wigner D coefficients and U blocks for a given lmax
precompute_wigner_coefficients: precompute Wigner D matrix coefficients for angular momentum levels lmin through lmax with symmetry optimization
quaternion_to_ra_rb_real: decompose a quaternion tensor into real and imaginary parts of Ra and Rb for Wigner D computation
wigner_d_matrix_real: compute Wigner D matrices from Ra and Rb real-pair components using precomputed coefficients and real arithmetic
wigner_d_pair_to_real: transform complex Wigner D matrices represented as real-pair into real spherical harmonic basis using U blocks
